units.leftText: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
units.rightText: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

units.leftText: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
units.rightText: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

units.leftText: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day
units.rightText: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers in a pure conscience, how unceasing is my remembrance of thee in my supplications, night and day

units.leftText: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
units.rightText: longing to see thee, remembering thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

units.leftText: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.
units.rightText: having been reminded of the unfeigned faith that is in thee; which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and, I am persuaded, in thee also.

units.leftText: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
units.rightText: For which cause I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee through the laying on of my hands.

units.leftText: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
units.rightText: For God gave us not a spirit of fearfulness; but of power and love and discipline.

units.leftText: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,
units.rightText: Be not ashamed therefore of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but suffer hardship with the gospel according to the power of God;

units.leftText: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
units.rightText: who saved us, and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

units.leftText: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.
units.rightText: but hath now been manifested by the appearing of our Saviour Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,

units.leftText: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
units.rightText: whereunto I was appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher.

units.leftText: For this cause I also suffer these things.
units.rightText: For which cause I suffer also these things: yet I am not ashamed; for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed unto him against that day.

units.leftText: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
units.rightText: Hold the pattern of sound words which thou hast heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

units.leftText: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
units.rightText: That good thing which was committed unto thee guard through the Holy Spirit which dwelleth in us.

units.leftText: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
units.rightText: This thou knowest, that all that are in Asia turned away from me; of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

units.leftText: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
units.rightText: The Lord grant mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus: for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain;

units.leftText: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me
units.rightText: but, when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently, and found me

units.leftText: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.
units.rightText: (the Lord grant unto him to find mercy of the Lord in that day); and in how many things he ministered at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

units.leftText: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
units.rightText: Thou therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

units.leftText: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.
units.rightText: And the things which thou hast heard from me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

units.leftText: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
units.rightText: Suffer hardship with me, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

units.leftText: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
units.rightText: No soldier on service entangleth himself in the affairs of this life; that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

units.leftText: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.
units.rightText: And if also a man contend in the games, he is not crowned, except he have contended lawfully.

units.leftText: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.
units.rightText: The husbandman that laboreth must be the first to partake of the fruits.

units.leftText: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.
units.rightText: Consider what I say; for the Lord shall give thee understanding in all things.

units.leftText: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,
units.rightText: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my gospel:

units.leftText: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
units.rightText: wherein I suffer hardship unto bonds, as a malefactor; but the word of God is not bound.

units.leftText: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
units.rightText: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

units.leftText: This saying is trustworthy:
units.rightText: Faithful is the saying: For if we died with him, we shall also live with him:

units.leftText: If we endure,
units.rightText: if we endure, we shall also reign with him: if we shall deny him, he also will deny us:

units.leftText: If we are faithless,
units.rightText: if we are faithless, he abideth faithful; for he cannot deny himself.

units.leftText: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.
units.rightText: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them in the sight of the Lord, that they strive not about words, to no profit, to the subverting of them that hear.

units.leftText: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
units.rightText: Give diligence to present thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, handling aright the word of truth.

units.leftText: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
units.rightText: But shun profane babblings: for they will proceed further in ungodliness,

units.leftText: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
units.rightText: and their word will eat as doth a gangrene: of whom is Hymenæus and Philetus;

units.leftText: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.
units.rightText: men who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already, and overthrow the faith of some.

units.leftText: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
units.rightText: Howbeit the firm foundation of God standeth, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his: and, Let every one that nameth the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.

units.leftText: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.
units.rightText: Now in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some unto honor, and some unto dishonor.

units.leftText: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.
units.rightText: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honor, sanctified, meet for the master’s use, prepared unto every good work.

units.leftText: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
units.rightText: But flee youthful lusts, and follow after righteousness, faith, love, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

units.leftText: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.
units.rightText: But foolish and ignorant questionings refuse, knowing that they gender strifes.

units.leftText: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,
units.rightText: And the Lord’s servant must not strive, but be gentle towards all, apt to teach, forbearing,

units.leftText: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,
units.rightText: in meekness correcting them that oppose themselves; if peradventure God may give them repentance unto the knowledge of the truth,

units.leftText: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.
units.rightText: and they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, having been taken captive by him unto his will.

units.leftText: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.
units.rightText: But know this, that in the last days grievous times shall come.

units.leftText: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
units.rightText: For men shall be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, haughty, railers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

units.leftText: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,
units.rightText: without natural affection, implacable, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, no lovers of good,

units.leftText: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
units.rightText: traitors, headstrong, puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;

units.leftText: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.
units.rightText: holding a form of godliness, but having denied the power thereof: from these also turn away.

units.leftText: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
units.rightText: For of these are they that creep into houses, and take captive silly women laden with sins, led away by divers lusts,

units.leftText: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
units.rightText: ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

units.leftText: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.
units.rightText: And even as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also withstand the truth; men corrupted in mind, reprobate concerning the faith.

units.leftText: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.
units.rightText: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be evident unto all men, as theirs also came to be.

units.leftText: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
units.rightText: But thou didst follow my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, patience,

units.leftText: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
units.rightText: persecutions, sufferings; what things befell me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: and out of them all the Lord delivered me.

units.leftText: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
units.rightText: Yea, and all that would live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

units.leftText: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
units.rightText: But evil men and impostors shall wax worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

units.leftText: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
units.rightText: But abide thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;

units.leftText: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
units.rightText: and that from a babe thou hast known the sacred writings which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

units.leftText: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,
units.rightText: Every scripture inspired of God is also profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for instruction which is in righteousness:
leftNotes: 3:16 or, Every writing inspired by God is

units.leftText: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
units.rightText: that the man of God may be complete, furnished completely unto every good work.

units.leftText: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:
units.rightText: I charge thee in the sight of God, and of Christ Jesus, who shall judge the living and the dead, and by his appearing and his kingdom:

units.leftText: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
units.rightText: preach the word; be urgent in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort, with all longsuffering and teaching.

units.leftText: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,
units.rightText: For the time will come when they will not endure the sound doctrine; but, having itching ears, will heap to themselves teachers after their own lusts;

units.leftText: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
units.rightText: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn aside unto fables.

units.leftText: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.
units.rightText: But be thou sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfil thy ministry.

units.leftText: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
units.rightText: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure is come.

units.leftText: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
units.rightText: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith:

units.leftText: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
units.rightText: henceforth there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give to me at that day; and not to me only, but also to all them that have loved his appearing.

units.leftText: Be diligent to come to me soon,
units.rightText: Give diligence to come shortly unto me:

units.leftText: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.
units.rightText: for Demas forsook me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

units.leftText: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
units.rightText: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee; for he is useful to me for ministering.

units.leftText: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
units.rightText: But Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.

units.leftText: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.
units.rightText: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, bring when thou comest, and the books, especially the parchments.

units.leftText: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
units.rightText: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord will render to him according to his works:

units.leftText: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.
units.rightText: of whom do thou also beware; for he greatly withstood our words.

units.leftText: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
units.rightText: At my first defence no one took my part, but all forsook me: may it not be laid to their account.

units.leftText: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
units.rightText: But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me; that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

units.leftText: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
units.rightText: The Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will save me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.

units.leftText: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
units.rightText: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

units.leftText: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.
units.rightText: Erastus remained at Corinth: but Trophimus I left at Miletus sick.

units.leftText: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
units.rightText: Give diligence to come before winter. Eubulus saluteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

units.leftText: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
units.rightText: The Lord be with thy spirit. Grace be with you.
